# 1 Enoch Chapter 70 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**70:1** And-it-came-to-pass after-this that-his-name-during-his-lifetime was-raised-aloft to-that-Son-of-Man and-to-the-Lord-of-Spirits from-amongst-those-who-dwell-on-the-earth.

**70:2** And-he-was-raised-aloft-on-the-chariots-of-the-spirit and-his-name-vanished-among-them.

**70:3** And-from-that-day-I-was-no-longer-numbered-amongst-them: and-he-set-me-between-the-two-winds, between-the-North and-the-West, where-the-angels-took-the-cords-to-measure-for-me-the-place-for-the-elect-and-righteous.

**70:4** And-there-I-saw the-first-fathers and-the-righteous-who-from-the-beginning-dwell-in-that-place.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 70 is the transitional chapter — Enoch is 'raised aloft' to join the Son of Man. The translation is ambiguous: does Enoch's name become identified with the Son of Man (i.e., they are merged), or is Enoch brought into the Son of Man's presence? V. 1 is the key: 'his name was raised aloft to that Son of Man.' The shift to first person in v. 3 is notable. 'The first fathers' in v. 4 = the antediluvian patriarchs.*
